title: Severe North Atlantic Turbulence Lasts 55% Longer
hook: The invisible rough air over the Atlantic is getting worse.
closing: Longer severe turbulence makes keeping your seatbelt fastened throughout every flight more important.
question: Have your flights felt bumpier?

segments.say: Severe turbulence reached 27.4 annual hours over the North Atlantic. Crossings now spend more time in dangerous invisible air.
Severe turbulence duration increased 55 percent. The worst bumps are growing faster than lighter ones.
Severe turbulence could reach 62 annual hours. Future Atlantic flights would spend far longer in dangerous rough air.
